events.name: cta_clicked
events.description: Fired when the landing page call-to-action is clicked, navigating to the listing page.

events.name: product_list_viewed
events.description: Fired when the product listing page successfully loads products from the catalog API.

events.name: product_detail_viewed

events.name: add_to_cart_clicked
events.description: Fired when a product is successfully added to the server-side session cart from the detail page.
